Dear FAM onboarding,

My name is Leonidio Amaral , and I am the new owner of Unit #104 in Canal West Residence - Arabian Apt 104 in Dubai Sports city.

I kindly request that you remove the unit from your management system and revoke any access or permissions associated with the previous management arrangement.

Furthermore, please provide me with all necessary details regarding the digital lock installed in the main door by your company and any other information required for me to assume full control of the lock system (including on how to change the access code).

Please confirm once the unit has been removed from your system and the digital lock access details have been transferred to me.

Thank you for your assistance, and I look forward to your prompt response.


Kind regards,


Best Regards,
Leonidio Amaral
